Jewish Cemetery of Cuneo

Cemetery · Cuneo, Italy

The original burial site, situated near the river Gesso, was purchased by the Lattes brothers in 1610. The site was shared with the Jews of the nearby community of Mondovì until 1730, but in the ‘30s it was completely dismantled to allow the construction of a ring road. The second cemetery was established in Calà degli Ebrei, the present-day Via della Pieve. The Community had for a long time used a section of the municipal cemetery. Guided visits are available.
